Title: Google Maps for Umbraco
Description: Two Google Maps property editors for Umbraco. Google Maps Single Marker pins one location; Google Maps Multi Marker holds many pins on one shared map, each with its own friendly name, description and colour from a palette you define on the data type. Editors search by address with Places autocomplete, click or drag to place a pin, or type a coordinate pair. Zoom, centre point, map type and SnazzyMaps styles are saved with the value so the front-end renders the map exactly as it was set up. A single map property can also exchange address data with other properties on the same content item or block, in either direction, so a picked place fills in street, city, postcode and coordinates for you. Ships property value converters, strongly-typed models and UFM components for block labels.

AuthorDetails.Name: Arnold Visser
AuthorDetails.Description: Umbraco developer and package author. Our.Umbraco.GMaps is maintained by Arnold together with Robert Foster and contributors from the Umbraco community.

Screenshots.Caption: The Single Marker editor: Places autocomplete, a draggable pin, an optional friendly name, and a readout of the pin, zoom and centre point that are saved with the value.
The Multi Marker editor: many numbered, colour-coded pins on one map, with a reorderable chip for each. Selecting a pin lets the search box move it rather than add another.
Data type settings: hide the map, enable the friendly name, set the API key, and choose the default centre and zoom.
Default Location is picked on a map — drag or search to choose the centre, and zooming sets the default zoom level to match.
Map type, SnazzyMaps styles or custom map style JSON, and property mapping — all configured per data type.
Property mapping pairs a map field with the alias of another property on the same content item or block.
Address data can flow into the map, out of it, or both ways.
